ValidationRule.description: Prevents the UAT automation suppression flag from being used on non-UAT opportunities.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Suppress_Automation_For_UAT__c, NOT(BEGINS(Name, "UAT - DO NOT SEND")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Suppress Automation For UAT can only be enabled on opportunities whose Name starts with UAT - DO NOT SEND.
